title: Lab overview
description: The whole lab at a glance: alerts, service checks, the hypervisor, every workstation, the servers and the automation. Dashboards live in git (roles/monitoring/files/grafana/dashboards).

panels.title: Firing alerts
panels.description: Alerts firing now; the table below lists them.

panels.title: Workstations
panels.description: By power state. Hibernated machines are suspended to disk and resume where they left off.

panels.title: Guest RAM
panels.description: RAM promised to portal workstations, running or not, against the portal's budget. Requests that don't fit are refused.

panels.title: pve01 CPU
panels.description: All cores.

panels.title: pve01 RAM
panels.description: In use: guests plus Proxmox itself.

panels.title: Disk pool
panels.description: local-lvm, the thin pool holding every guest disk. Thin-provisioned, so real use is what counts.

panels.title: Cert expiry
panels.description: Days until the soonest TLS certificate expires. Let's Encrypt renews at 30.

panels.title: Security
panels.description: Pending security updates, all machines.

panels.title: Firing alerts
panels.description: What's wrong now. Each alert links its runbook on Prometheus's alerts page.

panels.title: Service checks
panels.description: Each service probed from mgmt01 the way a user reaches it: HTTPS with a valid certificate, LDAPS, Kerberos, AD DNS, and the public sign-in page on the VPS.

panels.title: CPU by guest
panels.description: Cores in use per guest, stacked. Dashed: pve01's cores.

targets.expr: max by (name) (pve_cpu_usage_ratio * pve_cpu_usage_limit * on (id) group_left (name) pve_guest_info{template="0"})

panels.title: Memory by guest
panels.description: Per guest, stacked. Dashed: pve01's RAM. Hibernated guests use none.

panels.title: Storage pools
panels.description: local-lvm: guest disks. local: ISOs and backups.

panels.title: Disk I/O by guest
panels.description: Reads up, writes down.

panels.title: Network by guest
panels.description: Received up, sent down.

panels.title: Every workstation
panels.description: One row per workstation the lab keeps, from the lab's records and each machine's node_exporter. Hibernated machines show no live numbers. Click a name for its details.

panels.title: Access paths
panels.description: Can people get in? Every minute, blackbox checks each running workstation's SSH (also the browser terminal's path) and, on desktops, the Desktop button's path through pve01's console relay. Both stop at the banner, so nobody's session notices. Rows follow the machines (lab-metrics); a red row while the machine is up raises AccessPathDown.

panels.title: $workstation
panels.description: One panel per running workstation: they appear and disappear with the machines (Prometheus's target list, rewritten by lab-metrics every 30 seconds).

panels.title: Key services
panels.description: The services the lab depends on, as systemd reports them on each server (node_exporter's systemd collector). Probes above check the same services from the outside.

panels.title: Clock offset
panels.description: Offset from the time source. Kerberos fails at 5 minutes; the alert fires at 0.5 s. A guest resuming from hibernation wakes up behind until chrony steps the clock.

panels.title: VPS tunnel handshake
panels.description: WireGuard, pve01 to the VPS: the only way in from the internet. Renews every 2 minutes while the VPS answers.

panels.title: VPS tunnel traffic
panels.description: Visitors using the lab from the internet.

panels.title: Root disk use
panels.description: / on every machine.

panels.title: Pending updates
panels.description: Per machine, security and other updates (checked every 15 minutes).

panels.title: Reconciler last ran
panels.description: lab-reconcile.timer, every minute: deploys the release branch when it moves.

panels.title: Last full deploy
panels.description: The reconciler's last full run of site.yml.

panels.title: Latest release
panels.description: Whether the newest commit on the release branch deployed.

panels.title: Reconciler state
panels.description: Paused while /var/lib/lab/reconcile.paused exists (docs/operations.md).

panels.title: Operations, last 24 h
panels.description: Builds, deletes, image builds and deploys, by outcome. Unresolved: failed with no later success on the same machine, image or release. Details: Activity on the admin page.

panels.title: Golden images
panels.description: Age of each golden image (lab image build). New machines are clones of these.

panels.title: Workstations over time
panels.description: How many machines the lab keeps, and how many are awake.

panels.title: Memory budget over time
panels.description: Admission control: new workstations must fit under the budget.
